[[File:Music.png|thumb|125px]] ==Description== '''Tower Defense Simulator''' uses a wide range of soundtracks, many of them original and others taken from certain music sources. The game itself has dedicated music composers ([https://www.roblox.com/users/17914141/profile Phoqus] and [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile Enthrallist]) who create most of the music in the game. Most of the music listed here is copyrighted so therefore cannot be used for your own purposes unless you have exclusive permission from BelowNatural. In-game, these soundtracks may play for shorter length, but these are the full length versions of the soundtracks. The page also lists known IDs used to play the soundtracks in-game, most of which can be played with the [[DJ Booth]] if the player has the custom [[DJ Booth]] music gamepass. However, do note that some of the older IDs may not work, due to changes made in a Roblox audio privacy update on the 22th of March 2022. Internal names for soundtracks are listed on the page due to them being used in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, even if the soundtrack is not selectable there. __TOC__ ==Gameplay Soundtracks==
